tools.name: list_members
tools.description: List the workspace's members with their roles, and pending invites. Workspace owners only.

tools.name: invite_member
tools.description: Invite someone to the workspace by email address (or GitHub username) with a role. No email is sent: the result contains a short text with the sign-in link to pass on. They join when they sign in with that email (Google, or their primary GitHub email); an existing DenkOps user with that email is add

tools.name: set_member_role
tools.description: Change a workspace member's role (owner, member or viewer). The last owner can't be demoted. Workspace owners only.

tools.name: remove_member
tools.description: Remove a member from the workspace; their access (including chat connections) ends immediately. The last owner can't be removed. Workspace owners only.

tools.name: cancel_invite
tools.description: Cancel a pending workspace invite. Workspace owners only.

tools.name: get_project_access
tools.description: Show each member's workspace role and effective role on one project (none = the project is hidden from them). Workspace owners only.

tools.name: set_project_access
tools.description: Set a member's role on one project: none (hidden), viewer, member or owner — or inherit to fall back to their workspace role. Workspace owners only.

tools.name: get_member_access
tools.description: List the per-project role overrides of one workspace member. Workspace owners only.

tools.name: get_connector_access
tools.description: Show who may connect to a connector project (public, an email allowlist, or workspace members) and which sign-in methods are allowed. Workspace owners only.

tools.name: set_connector_access
tools.description: Change who may connect to a connector project: public on/off, the email allowlist (replaces it), allowed sign-in providers (github, google, microsoft; null = all) and email/password accounts on/off. Omitted fields stay. Workspace owners only.

tools.name: list_connector_accounts
tools.description: List the email/password accounts that can sign in to a connector project. Workspace owners only.

tools.name: add_connector_account
tools.description: Create an email/password account for a connector project. A strong password is generated and shown only once; pass it to the person securely. Password sign-in must be enabled for it to work. Workspace owners only.

tools.name: reset_connector_account_password
tools.description: Generate a new password for a connector project's email/password account; the old one stops working. Shown only once. Workspace owners only.

tools.name: remove_connector_account
tools.description: Delete an email/password account from a connector project. Workspace owners only.

tools.name: update_connection_scopes
tools.description: Change what a connection token may do: env / public paths / egress access (none, read, write), whether it may create projects, and which projects it may touch (null = all). Not for the connection this chat uses. Workspace owners only.

tools.name: regenerate_connection
tools.description: Issue a new token for a connection and revoke the old one (e.g. after a leak). The new token is shown only once. Not for the connection this chat uses. Workspace owners only.

tools.name: get_connection_activity
tools.description: Show recent actions performed with one connection token. Workspace owners only.

tools.name: list_alert_rules
tools.description: List the workspace's alert rules (crash, killed, rate_limit, deploy_failed) and where they notify. Workspace owners only.

tools.name: create_alert_rule
tools.description: Create an alert rule for an event (crash, killed, rate_limit, deploy_failed) on one project or all, optionally posting to an https webhook (e.g. Slack). Workspace owners only.

tools.name: update_alert_rule
tools.description: Turn an alert rule on/off or change its webhook (null removes it). Workspace owners only.

tools.name: delete_alert_rule
tools.description: Delete an alert rule. Workspace owners only.

tools.name: list_alert_events
tools.description: Show recent alert events (crashes, kills, rate limits, failed deploys). Workspace owners only.

tools.name: get_audit_log
tools.description: Show the workspace's recent audit log: who did what, when. Workspace owners only.

tools.name: list_deployments
tools.description: List a project's deployed versions (newest first) with status and when; the active version is marked. Useful before rolling back.

tools.name: set_cron_enabled
tools.description: Pause (enabled=false) or resume (enabled=true) a project's scheduled job.

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List the workspaces of the signed-in account with roles, and which one this connection acts in.

tools.name: create_workspace
tools.description: Create a new workspace owned by the signed-in person. This connection keeps acting in its current workspace; reconnect to use the new one.

tools.name: get_workspace_overview
tools.description: One overview of the workspace: slot usage and every project with status, active version and latest memory/CPU use.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List the DenkOps projects in the signed-in workspace with their status and URL.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Get a DenkOps project's status and active version by project_id.

tools.name: get_container_logs
tools.description: Read recent container logs for a DenkOps project, e.g. to debug a failing deploy. Optional `since` (15m, 2h, 3d or an ISO timestamp) and `level` (a token matched in the log line, e.g. error) filter the persisted log store.

tools.name: rollback
tools.description: Roll a DenkOps project back to a previous healthy version (omit version for the previous one).

tools.name: stop_project
tools.description: Stop a DenkOps deployment: its containers stop and it goes offline. Reversible by starting the project again.

tools.name: start_project
tools.description: Start a stopped DenkOps deployment again (reactivates its active version).

tools.name: delete_project
tools.description: PERMANENTLY delete a DenkOps deployment and ALL its data (containers, images, volume and records). Cannot be undone. Only deletes when `confirm` equals the project's exact slug; without it nothing is deleted and the confirmation requirement is returned.

tools.name: list_env
tools.description: List a DenkOps project's environment variable KEYS (values are write-only and never shown), and whether changes are pending a redeploy.

tools.name: set_env
tools.description: Set or overwrite a DenkOps project's environment variable (for secrets such as API keys). Values are write-only. The change is staged and takes effect on the next deploy or redeploy. Reserved keys (DENKOPS_*) are rejected.

tools.name: unset_env
tools.description: Delete a DenkOps project's environment variable. Takes effect on the next deploy or redeploy.

tools.name: redeploy
tools.description: Re-run the current version of a DenkOps project to apply staged env or path changes or restart the app. Reuses the last upload; no code is sent.

tools.name: get_public_paths
tools.description: List a DenkOps project's public (unauthenticated) paths, plus the routes DenkOps has observed the app serve.

tools.name: set_public_paths
tools.description: Replace a DenkOps project's list of public (unauthenticated) paths. The change is staged and takes effect on the next deploy or redeploy.

tools.name: get_egress_policy
tools.description: Read a project's outbound-network (egress) allow-list policy: enabled, allowed hosts and recently blocked hosts.

tools.name: set_egress_policy
tools.description: Set a project's egress allow-list. enabled=true is default-deny: only listed hosts (exact or *.domain) may be reached. Allow-list edits apply live; enabling or disabling applies on the next deploy.

tools.name: add_domain
tools.description: Attach a custom domain to a DenkOps project. Returns the DNS TXT record (and CNAME target) to set at the DNS provider; the domain starts routing once its TXT record is verified.

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: List a DenkOps project's custom domains and whether each is verified.

tools.name: verify_domain
tools.description: Check a DenkOps custom domain's DNS TXT record and activate routing when it is present. Reports not-verified if the record isn't visible yet.

tools.name: remove_domain
tools.description: Detach a custom domain from a DenkOps project.

tools.name: list_traces
tools.description: List recent request traces for a DenkOps project (name, status, duration, span count).

tools.name: get_trace
tools.description: Get the spans of a single DenkOps request trace by project_id and trace_id.

tools.name: get_metrics
tools.description: Get a DenkOps project's request metrics (latency percentiles, error rate), latest resource sample and rejected-request count over the last 24h.

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List the workspace's DenkOps connection tokens (scoped, revocable agent/CLI credentials): label, agent type, scopes and status. Workspace owners only.

tools.name: create_connection
tools.description: Mint a new scoped, revocable DenkOps connection token for a CLI, CI job or agent (e.g. GitHub Actions deploys). The token is returned exactly once and cannot be retrieved again. Workspace owners only.

tools.name: revoke_connection
tools.description: Immediately revoke a DenkOps connection token by its connection_id. Workspace owners only.

tools.name: list_crons
tools.description: List a project's managed scheduled (cron) jobs with next and last run and status.

tools.name: run_cron
tools.description: Trigger a managed scheduled job immediately (recorded as a manual run).

tools.name: get_denkops_guide
tools.description: Explains how to structure, configure (denkops.json) and deploy a DenkOps project: bun-Hono or python-FastAPI APIs and MCP servers built with defineMcp.

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Show the workspace's plan: slots used and still free, subscription status and renewal date, and prices. Use it when a new project might not fit or the user asks about their plan or slots.

tools.name: get_billing_link
tools.description: Get a one-click Stripe link for this workspace: subscribe (optionally with extra slots), add slots to an existing subscription, or fix a failed payment. Nothing is charged until the user confirms on Stripe. Workspace owners only; other members are told which owner to ask.

tools.name: get_connector_branding
tools.description: Show the brand colours and icon used on a connector project's hosted sign-in and consent pages.

tools.name: set_connector_branding
tools.description: Brand a connector project's hosted sign-in and consent pages: accent colour (buttons/links), background colour (hex like #2563eb; null resets to the DenkOps default) and/or an icon (PNG, JPEG or WebP as base64, max 2 MB). Omitted fields stay unchanged; text colour is chosen automatically for contras

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Show which DenkOps account and workspace this connection acts as.

tools.name: deploy
tools.description: Deploy a project to DenkOps by sending its files, and get the live URL back. Include every source file (and denkops.json if the project has one; without it a new project is created, named from `name`, package.json or pyproject.toml). Pass project_id to ship a new version of an existing project. Secr

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_connector_access, list_connector_accounts, update_connection_scopes, list_projects, deploy · Private data: set_connector_access, list_connector_accounts, add_connector_account, reset_connector_account_password, remove_connector_account, update_connection_scopes, regenerate_connection, get_connection_activity, get_container_logs, delete_project, list_env, set_env, unset_env, add_domain, verify_domain, list_connections, create_connection, revoke_connection, deploy · Public sink: invite_member, get_connector_access, set_connector_access, list_connector_accounts, add_connector_account, reset_connector_account_password, remove_connector_account, list_alert_rules, create_alert_rule, update_alert_rule, redeploy · Destructive: remove_member, reset_connector_account_password, remove_connector_account, delete_alert_rule, delete_project, set_env, unset_env, redeploy, remove_domain, list_crons, run_cron.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_connector_access, list_connector_accounts, update_connection_scopes, list_projects, deploy · Private data: set_connector_access, list_connector_accounts, add_connector_account, reset_connector_account_password, remove_connector_account, update_connection_scopes, regenerate_connection, get_connection_activity, get_container_logs, delete_project, list_env, set_env, unset_env, add_domain, verify_domain, list_connections, create_connection, revoke_connection, deploy · Public sink: invite_member, get_connector_access, set_connector_access, list_connector_accounts, add_connector_account, reset_connector_account_password, remove_connector_account, list_alert_rules, create_alert_rule, update_alert_rule, redeploy · Destructive: remove_member, reset_connector_account_password, remove_connector_account, delete_alert_rule, delete_project, set_env, unset_env, redeploy, remove_domain, list_crons, run_cron

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
